banglaExplanation: Formal assessment-এর আগে candidate সত্যিই ready কিনা, সেটা দেখতে self assessment করানো হয়।
Candidate প্রতিটি performance criteria পড়ে Yes বা No দেয়।
শেষে সে লিখে সই করে যে সে formal assessment-এর জন্য ready।
এতে learner নিজের learning-এ active role নেয়, শুধু assessor-এর উপর নির্ভর করে না।

example.bn: ওয়েল্ডিং trainee প্রতিটি criteria-র পাশে Yes বা No টিক দিয়ে শেষে সই করে।
example.en: A welding trainee reads each performance criterion and ticks Yes or No. Then he signs the form.

extra.note_bn: Candidate প্রতিটি criteria পড়ে Yes বা No দেয়, শেষে ready লিখে সই করে। এই সই-ই full consent নিশ্চিত করে।
rows: 1.1 Safe work practices observed and personal protective equipment (PPE) worn as required for the work performed.
2.1 Weld requirements, specifications are identified from work place drawing.
3.2 Materials (plate) are marked and cut as per dimension of specification, drawing.
3.3 Edges are prepared as per job specification to meet industry requirements.
3.4 Materials are assembled and aligned with required gap.
3.5 Weld gauge and or measuring instruments are used as per workplace/industry requirements.
4.1 Job is set up using a clamp at required position (1G or 2G)
5.1. Welding equipment is set up and adjusted as per job requirements.
6.1 Weld is performed as per specification and standard (WPS).
6.2 Welds are cleaned in accordance with standard operating procedures
6.3. Weld is checked for quality and any defects are identified and corrective action is taken to standard operating procedures.
7.1 Equipment is cleaned and stored according to workplace procedures.

short.modelAnswer:
Self assessment checks the candidate's readiness for formal assessment.
1. The assessor's role is to ensure candidates are ready for assessment.
2. The candidate answers Yes or No for each performance criterion.
3. The candidate signs: "I now feel ready to undertake my formal competency assessment."
4. The learner plays an active role, with the right balance between assessor and learner.
